summary: Full E2E test of Margin unit-economics MVP. Backend 13/13 pytest pass (auth + brute-force lockout + businesses + simulations + ownership). Frontend E2E (register -> first business -> offers -> save sim -> money models with full step dialog -> save model -> reload persistence -> journey + ICP + value prop -> dashboard metrics + totals -> second business isolation -> logout -> wrong-password error -> admin login) all pass. Math verified against calc.js: price=500/cost=100/take=50%/non-recurring/whenDays=0 -> 30day rev $250, 30day GP $200, LTV $200, target CAC $66.67. 100 customers totals: $25,000 rev / $20,000 GP / $20,000 LTV. App is in good shape.

issues: 'Add to my model' button is disabled until offer name + price are valid -- correct behaviour, but no inline hint to the user about why; consider a helper text under the button when disabled.

critical_code_review_comments: CORS: app uses allow_credentials=True with allow_origins=['*'] (from CORS_ORIGINS='*' default). Browsers reject credentialed requests against wildcard origins. In this preview env the frontend works because requests are same-origin through the ingress, but for production CORS_ORIGINS should be an explicit list (e.g. https://app.margin.com). Recommend tightening before deploy.
Auth cookies set with secure=False and samesite='lax'. Works for preview (HTTPS terminates at ingress), but should be secure=True in prod. Consider deriving from env var.

Pydantic EmailStr (via email-validator) rejects .test/.example/.invalid TLDs at runtime. Make sure marketing/docs/examples don't suggest those domains for sign-up, and update test fixtures (already handled in backend_test.py with @margintest.io).
server.py: @app.on_event('startup' / 'shutdown') are deprecated in modern FastAPI -- consider lifespan handler (minor).
Money-model step button validation: requires price>0 but allows takeRate=0 (results in $0). Acceptable, but could warn the user.
All MongoDB queries correctly exclude {_id: 0}. UUID string ids used. Good.
test_credentials: admin@margin.app / Admin123! (verified). Fresh registered users use @margintest.io domain (email-validator rejects .test TLD).
seed_data_creation: None persisted intentionally. Test runs create disposable users + businesses prefixed with TEST_/e2e_. Admin seeding on backend startup verified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Routes: /, /offers, /models (NOT /money-models), /journey, /auth. Frontend dashboard route uses path 'models' for money models page. Test domain for registration must be a real TLD (e.g. @margintest.io) since pydantic EmailStr rejects .test/.example. Brute-force lockout is per ip:email, 5 fails => 429 for 15 min -- use unique fake emails so admin isn't locked. Math constants: calc.js modelMetrics uses Math.min(12, 12 - floor(whenDays/30)) months for recurring; non-recurring counts once if whenDays <= 30 (30day) and <= 365 (LTV). healthyCAC = ltvGP/3, maxCAC = day30GP. Frontend public URL: https://simple-money-6.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend tests: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py.
